title: Psalm 20
content:
In Your strength, O Lord, the king rejoices,* in Your salvation he is glad indeed.
You have given him his heart’s desire* and have not withheld the request of his lips.
For You established him with blessings of goodness;* You placed a crown of precious stones/gold upon his head.
He asked You for life and You gave it to him,* length of days forever and ever.
Great is his glory in Your salvation;* glory and majesty You lay upon him.
For You will give him a blessing forever and ever;* You will gladden him with the joy of Your face.
For the king trusts in the Lord,* and through the mercy of the Most High he shall not be moved.
May Your hand reach all Your enemies;* may Your right hand find all who hate You.
You shall make them like a fiery furnace* when Your face appears.
The Lord will destroy them in His anger,* and fire will devour them.
You will wipe out their offspring from the earth* and their seed from among the children of men.
For they plotted evil against You,* they devised purposes they could not fulfill.
For You will put them to flight;* You will ready Your arrows against their face.
Be exalted, O Lord, in Your strength;* we will sing and praise Your might.
